stories.title: Update: Barapullah Phase III congestion at Suryaghadi and Ashram; police and PWD weigh fixes
stories.body: Delhi Traffic Police and the PWD are considering changes after congestion on the new Barapullah Phase III corridor, reported on Thursday 1 October. Time Out and The Tribune report a jam of about 3 km from Mayur Vihar Phase I towards Sarai Kale Khan, and slow movement at Suryaghadi and at Ashram, where traffic from DND, Sarai Kale Khan and the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway converges. Police were directed to strengthen deployment at merge and exit points. A PWD official said the AIIMS-to-Mayur Vihar carriageway would open on Thursday afternoon. Closing the Suryaghadi cloverleaf to link Phase III directly with Phase I is among the options being considered, a Joint Commissioner of Police said.
stories.check: NEEDS CHECK: confirm whether the AIIMS-to-Mayur Vihar carriageway opened on Thursday 1 October and whether any Suryaghadi closure has been decided. A separate ANC report cites a police drone survey (six lanes merging into three; signals proposed on the corridor) that was not seen in the other two reports. Sources differ on the opening date (Time Out says 29 September; the Tribune's earlier report said 30 September).

stories.title: Jamia Millia Islamia placed in 501-550 band of Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2027
stories.body: Jamia Millia Islamia has been placed in the 501-550 band of the Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2027, according to a university press release dated Thursday 1 October. An education news site, Eduadvice, reported the same band on Wednesday 30 September. The same report says the 2027 edition covers 2,297 universities across 118 countries, up from 2,191 a year earlier, and lists IISc Bengaluru as India's top institution at joint 254th. The Jamia release page carries the headline with English, Hindi and Urdu PDFs; the PDF text was not read for this brief, so no comment from the university is reported here.
stories.check: Open the English PDF of the release to confirm the band, any comparison with last year and any university statement. The release is dated 1 Oct while Eduadvice published on 30 Sep.
